| Github Access Token | `token` | Secured | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-token)` | Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token |
| Owner | `owner` | Text | Yes |  | The organization or user that owns the repository |
| Repository | `repo` | Text | Yes |  | The repository name, without the owner |

## Create GitHub Issue

Opens an issue in a repository. Works with a GitHub App installation token (Issues: write) or a personal access token. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/issues#create-an-issue

- **Slug:** `create-github-issue`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | Text | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-url)` | Defaults to the GitHub API URL the workspace's GitHub integration shares |
| Github Access Token | `token` | Secured | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-token)` | Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token |
| Owner | `owner` | Text | Yes |  | The organization or user that owns the repository |
| Repository | `repo` | Text | Yes |  | The repository name, without the owner |
| Title | `title` | Text | Yes |  |  |
| Body | `body` | Text Area | No |  | The issue text, in Markdown |
| Labels | `labels` | Text | No |  | Label names, comma- or newline-separated. GitHub drops labels, assignees and milestone silently without push access |
| Assignees | `assignees` | Text | No |  | Logins, comma- or newline-separated |
| Milestone | `milestone` | Text | No |  | The milestone number |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `issueNumber` | The new issue's number |
| `issueUrl` | The issue's web URL |
| `issueId` | The issue's ID |

### Example

Open an issue when a nightly check fails, with the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares. See [Create an issue from a workflow](../guides/connect-github#create-an-issue-from-a-workflow).

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| **Task name** | `open-issue` |
| **URL** | Leave `$(workspace.params.github-url)` |
| **Github Access Token** | Leave `$(workspace.params.github-token)` |
| **Owner** | `my-org` |
| **Repository** | `website` |
| **Title** | `Nightly check failed` |
| **Body** | `The nightly check failed in run $(context.params.workflowrun-ref).` |
| **Labels** | `bug,nightly` |

The task returns:

| Result | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `issueNumber` | The new issue's number, such as `42` |
| `issueUrl` | Its web address, such as `https://github.com/my-org/website/issues/42` |
| `issueId` | GitHub's numeric ID for the issue |

Link `open-issue` from the check with a failure link, so it runs only when the check fails. A later task can post `$(tasks.open-issue.results.issueUrl)`.

### Common problems

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The task fails before it runs, with `no such workspace param 'github-token'` | The workspace doesn't share the GitHub token. The editor warns about it when you save. | Share the token: see [Share the installation token with tasks](../guides/connect-github#share-the-installation-token-with-tasks). Or enter a personal access token in **Github Access Token**. |
| The task fails with `GitHub createIssue failed: HTTP 404: Not Found` | **Owner** or **Repository** is wrong, or the token can't see the repository: GitHub answers 404 for a private repository it hides from you. | Check both fields, and that the GitHub App is installed on the repository. |
| The task fails with `GitHub createIssue failed: HTTP 410: Issues are disabled for this repo` | The repository has issues turned off, as a fork does by default. | Turn on issues in the repository's settings on GitHub. |
| The issue is created without its labels or assignees | GitHub drops labels, assignees and milestone, without an error, when the token has no push access to the repository. | Use a token that can write to the repository. |

## Get GitHub File Contents

Reads one file from a repository at a branch, tag or commit. Works with a GitHub App installation token (Contents: read) or a personal access token. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents#get-repository-content

- **Slug:** `get-github-file-contents`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | Text | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-url)` | Defaults to the GitHub API URL the workspace's GitHub integration shares |
| Github Access Token | `token` | Secured | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-token)` | Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token |
| Owner | `owner` | Text | Yes |  | The organization or user that owns the repository |
| Repository | `repo` | Text | Yes |  | The repository name, without the owner |
| File Path | `path` | Text | Yes |  | The file's path in the repository, e.g. config/app.yaml |
| Ref | `ref` | Text | No |  | The branch, tag or commit SHA. Blank is the default branch |
| Output File | `outputFile` | Text | No |  | A workspace path to write the file to, absolute or relative to /workspace. Needed for a file over 3000 bytes or one that is not UTF-8 text |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | The file's text, when it is UTF-8 and fits in a result (3000 bytes); otherwise empty and the file is in Output File |
| `sha` | The file's blob SHA |
| `size` | The file's size in bytes |
| `outputPath` | The absolute path of Output File, when set |

## Set GitHub Commit Status

Sets a commit status (the check shown on a commit and its pull requests). Works with a GitHub App installation token (Commit statuses: write) or a personal access token. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/statuses#create-a-commit-status

- **Slug:** `set-github-commit-status`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | Text | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-url)` | Defaults to the GitHub API URL the workspace's GitHub integration shares |
| Github Access Token | `token` | Secured | Yes | `$(workspace.params.github-token)` | Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token |
| Owner | `owner` | Text | Yes |  | The organization or user that owns the repository |
| Repository | `repo` | Text | Yes |  | The repository name, without the owner |
| Commit SHA | `sha` | Text | Yes |  |  |
| State | `state` | Select | Yes |  |  |
| Context | `context` | Text | No |  | The status's name, e.g. flow/build. Blank is GitHub's 'default'; each context is its own status |
| Target URL | `targetUrl` | Text | No |  | Where the status links, e.g. the Flow run |
| Description | `description` | Text | No |  | A short summary; GitHub takes 140 characters, so a longer one is shortened |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `statusId` | The status's ID |
